description: This file defines the Book entity class for a book-tracking application. It includes fields for book metadata such as title, author, genres, publication details, and relationships to Shelves, Tags, and Publishers. It also provides utility methods for managing these relationships and converting edition numbers into human-readable strings.

classes.name: Book
classes.description: Entity class representing a book, with fields for metadata, relationships, and utility methods. Supports builder pattern via Lombok, JPA annotations for persistence, and serialization configurations.

methods.name: convertToBookEdition
methods.description: Converts an integer edition number into a human-readable string with ordinal suffix (e.g., 1st edition).

methods.name: setEdition
methods.description: Sets the edition string based on an integer input by converting it using 'convertToBookEdition'.

methods.name: addTag
methods.description: Associates a Tag with the Book, updating both the Book and Tag's collections.

methods.name: removeTag
methods.description: Removes a Tag from the Book, updating both the Book and Tag's collections.

methods.name: addPredefinedShelf
methods.description: Associates a PredefinedShelf with the Book, updating the shelf’s collection.

methods.name: removePredefinedShelf
methods.description: Disassociates the current predefined shelf from the Book.

methods.name: removeAuthor
methods.description: Removes the associated Author from the Book.

methods.name: setPublicationYear
methods.description: Sets the publication year for the Book.

methods.name: addGenre
methods.description: Adds a genre to the set of genres for the Book.

methods.name: addPublisher
methods.description: Associates a Publisher with the Book, updating both collections.

methods.name: removePublisher
methods.description: Removes a Publisher association from the Book.
